targetUse: in-game web ARPG UI supporting art, decorative; all Korean labels remain DOM text

model.name: LuminarQMix SDXL v7
model.runtime: Windows native diffusion-win Python, invoked through Windows PowerShell
model.promptNote: Full submitted prompts are recorded. First-pass selected room/merchant/hearth used CLIP-truncated trailing style tokens, visible in generation log. Compact prop retries avoid relying on the discarded tail.

style: Weathered medieval fantasy; oak, limestone and iron, umber/olive neutrals, warm amber light. Stylized game illustration, not photorealism.

encoding.postprocessing: RGB conversion and Lanczos downscale only. No text or final shapes painted over model output.

review.method: Private direct image/contact-sheet inspection; no browser screenshots
rejectedReasons: Closed/distant chest instead of prominent open storage chest
People or generated writing in initial book/bag/map artwork
Malformed anvil silhouettes in unguided retries
